test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 13 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: 'Startup India' is a major initiative by the Government of India. In which year was it launched?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2016**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Startup India** is a flagship initiative of the Government of India, intended to build a strong ecosystem that is conducive for the growth of startup businesses.
 
• The campaign was first announced by Indian Prime Minister **Narendra Modi during his speech on 15 August 2015.**
 
• The **Startup India** initiative was officially launched on **16 January 2016.**
 
• The objective of the campaign is to create a strong ecosystem for nurturing innovation and startups in the country that will drive sustainable economic growth and generate large scale employment opportunities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Startup India Action Plan:**

 
 
• The action plan for Startup India was unveiled by the Prime Minister on January 16, 2016, and it includes measures for the creation of incubation centers, easier patent filing, tax exemptions, and ease of setting up businesses.
 
• It aims to simplify the startup process, offers financial support, and provides a favorable environment for startups to flourish.
 
 
 
• **Fund of Funds for Startups (FFS):**
 
 
• To provide funding support to startups, the Government of India has set up a Fund of Funds with a corpus of INR 10,000 crore, managed by the Small Industries Development Bank of India (SIDBI).
 
• The FFS aims to support various alternative investment funds (AIFs) which in turn invest in startups.
 
 
 
• **Startup India Hub:**
 
 
• The Startup India Hub has been established to resolve queries and provide hand-holding support to startups throughout their lifecycle.
 
• The Hub acts as a single point of contact for the startup ecosystem, enabling knowledge exchange and access to funding.
 
 
 
• **Tax Exemptions:**
 
 
• Startups are eligible for an income tax exemption for three consecutive years out of their first ten years since incorporation.
 
• Exemptions are also provided from capital gains tax and investments above the fair market value.
